requirement: Every customer-facing capability shall state supported sources, required coverage, limitations, and regional/profile availability.
A sensor event shall not be presented directly as an authoritative enterprise finding.
Incomplete capabilities shall be disabled by server-side entitlement or capability checks, not hidden only in the UI.
A capability shall not be called GA until the GA definition of done and applicable release gate are satisfied.
All producer records shall use a small common envelope plus a typed record family and versioned source profile.
The common envelope shall identify tenant environment producer workload profile schema record lifecycle privacy time integrity and correlation semantics.
Source records shall not contain a producer-assigned canonical entity ID.
Schemas shall distinguish absent unknown redacted unsupported and not-applicable values.
Lifecycle shall support upsert correction tombstone source revision supersession epoch reset and snapshot reconciliation.
Protocol schemas shall use JSON Schema 2020-12 and product HTTP contracts shall use OpenAPI 3.1.2.
Canonical serialization and digest rules shall be deterministic and versioned using the adopted RFC 8785 profile and errata.
The Edge Runtime shall provide one production implementation of privacy validation WAL delivery policy cache command verification health and update behavior.
An adapter acknowledgement of admitted shall mean the record is durably represented in the local WAL.
The runtime shall not silently delete an admitted record under network disk or memory pressure.
Sampling aggregation or shedding shall occur before durable admission and shall be visible through coverage semantics.
The WAL shall survive supported process restart host restart update and rollback scenarios within the certified profile.
Edge diagnostics shall be bounded privacy-safe and sufficient to identify capture durability delivery policy and software health separately.
The protected workload shall not be indefinitely blocked solely because telemetry delivery is unavailable unless an explicit certified policy declares that behavior.
Every producer shall authenticate with a tenant environment region profile and workload-bound identity.
Bootstrap credentials shall be time-bounded and shall not serve as permanent producer credentials.
Every producer release shall present or resolve to a signed immutable capability manifest.
Ingest and command authorization shall reject capabilities absent from the centrally admitted manifest.
Production capability claims shall resolve to a current certification for the exact artifact and deployment profile.
Compromised or unsupported producer releases shall be revocable without deleting their prior evidence.
Enrollment update credential rotation and revocation shall be observable and auditable.
Regional ingest shall authenticate route validate and durably accept evidence before acknowledgement.
Acceptance shall create an authenticated receipt covering producer epoch sequence and accepted record identity.
Ingest shall be idempotent by tenant producer epoch and record identity and shall quarantine identity collisions with different digests.
Accepted source evidence shall be immutable; corrections and deletions shall append.
Permanent and retryable rejection classes shall be machine-distinguishable and shall not masquerade as acceptance.
Quarantine shall isolate by tenant and region and support audited repair reprocessing retention and coverage consequences.
Replay shall preserve original evidence and bind outputs to exact schema normalizer resolver and materializer versions.
Every source profile shall register field authority identifier stability lifecycle deletion privacy freshness and normalization semantics.
Normalizers shall preserve source evidence references and shall not assign canonical entity IDs.
Normalizer output shall identify the exact normalizer and catalog version.
Lossy conversion shall be explicit and original accepted values shall remain available under evidence authorization.
Reprocessing shall build candidate outputs and provide impact diffs before promotion.
Unknown source enum schema and distribution drift shall be monitored and attributable to producer/profile versions.
Field authority shall be field- and scope-specific rather than assigned to an entire source globally.
Only the tenant-cell resolver shall assign canonical entity IDs.
Identity shall be represented through immutable claims source-object links resolution decisions and canonical projections.
Automatic resolution shall prefer exact authoritative and verified bridge claims before probabilistic matching.
Names and display labels alone shall never trigger an automatic canonical merge.
Hard constraints negative evidence and customer not-same decisions shall prevent unsupported merges.
Every merge and split shall be effective-dated explainable auditable reversible and propagated through deterministic rematerialization.
Resolver quality shall be measured with impact-weighted false-merge precision recall review workload and stability metrics.
Canonical operational state shall be authoritative in tenant-cell PostgreSQL.
Canonical facts and relationships shall record valid time system time source claims authority and version.
Field materialization shall follow the authority map and shall not use arbitrary JSON last-write-wins merging.
Canonical mutation and projection event shall commit in one database transaction through a transactional outbox.
ClickHouse graph search and cache shall be rebuildable projections and shall not be required to reconstruct canonical authority.
Projection rebuild shall occur in a candidate namespace with validation atomic promotion and rollback.
Canonical identifiers shall be tenant-scoped stable opaque and never recycled.
Activity shall preserve separate source events normalized candidates correlated executions summaries and aggregates.
W3C trace context shall be used only for a real causal transaction crossing components.
Scans snapshots and independent observations shall use observation execution or reconciliation identifiers rather than fabricated trace parentage.
Every probabilistic correlation shall record members rule version confidence supporting and conflicting facts.
Principal semantics shall distinguish human service device-local browser-profile workload delegated pseudonymous and unknown identities.
Normal activity and analytics shall operate without prompt response tool-result or document content.
Late duplicate reordered corrected and cancelled execution events shall produce deterministic versioned outcomes.
Each GA insight definition shall declare evidence identity coverage severity lifecycle suppression remediation quality and limitations.
Finding severity shall be derived from an approved rubric and material reasons rather than producer-supplied severity.
Findings using new all stopped absence began or rates shall satisfy their coverage admission contract.
Coverage loss shall pause unsupported auto-resolution and expose evaluation-degraded state.
A finding shall expose what happened why it matters affected entities evidence limitations and recommended action.
Cases shall preserve owner status SLA evidence decisions approvals commands external references and immutable history.
A remediation shall not be represented as verified solely because a command was dispatched or an adapter returned success.
Every GA metric shall declare grain numerator denominator eligible population source coverage time correction dimensions privacy and version.
Percentages shall expose their denominator excluded population freshness and applicable coverage.
Estimated provider-billed and customer-contract cost shall be represented as distinct values with provenance.
Price currency exchange and allocation inputs shall be effective-dated and versioned.
Identity resolution changes and late evidence shall restate affected metrics under a recorded version.
Anomaly definitions shall declare baseline history seasonality materiality missing-data behavior and measured quality.
Analytical workloads and exports shall not exhaust resources reserved for ingest control canonical mutation or interactive reads.
Policy objects shall be immutable by version and shall declare owner purpose selectors conditions outcomes precedence coverage rollout rollback and lifecycle.
Policy publication exception approval command authority and break-glass shall enforce explicit roles and separation of duties.
Every decision shall reference exact policy evaluator entity fact coverage and exception versions and shall emit structured reasons.
Policy conflicts and defaults shall resolve through deterministic declared precedence rather than list ordering.
Policy authors shall be able to validate preview simulate compare observe stage pause and roll back within their authorized scope.
Exceptions shall be scoped time-bounded approved auditable and automatically expire.
Policy evaluation failure stale context and insufficient coverage shall have explicit customer-visible behavior.
Commands shall be typed signed tenant-bound target-bound capability-bound idempotent preconditioned and time-bounded.
Arbitrary shell script SQL or opaque executable payloads shall not be supported as sensor commands.
Command delivery shall be at least once and local execution shall be idempotent under the registered command contract.
Command state shall distinguish authorization delivery acceptance execution terminal outcome and effect evaluation.
High-impact actions shall support configured approval blast-radius limit cohort rollout pause and emergency stop.
Effect verification shall use direct postcondition independent sensor authoritative reconciliation subsequent evaluation or explicit customer confirmation.
Workflow definitions shall be versioned and running instances shall preserve version and migration history.
Managed connectors shall emit evidence and normalized claims rather than directly mutating product read models.
Connector credentials shall use least privilege encrypted secret storage rotation audit and region binding.
Webhooks shall be authenticated replay-protected durably received and idempotent.
Polling and reconciliation shall record scope pages cursors watermarks completeness errors and rate limits.
Source absence shall not be inferred from an incomplete partial or failed snapshot.
Disconnect shall preview coverage retention credential and workflow consequences and shall not silently erase history.
Every launch connector shall pass source-version pagination throttling cursor-reset privacy scale and deletion certification.
Product APIs shall serve canonical product read models and shall not reconstruct identity through live fan-out to sensor services.
Every request shall enforce tenant environment role attribute field purpose and evidence/content-grant authorization as applicable.
Mutation APIs shall support idempotency and optimistic version preconditions where concurrent change is material.
List APIs shall use deterministic cursor pagination and allowlisted filters/sorts.
The UI shall expose freshness coverage provenance and confidence where they materially affect a decision.
Bulk actions shall provide immutable scope preview bounded execution per-item results and audit.
Exports shall be asynchronous watermarked encrypted access-controlled expiring region-bound and audited.
Cross-tenant evidence identity policy control search cache analytics export and audit access shall be impossible by construction and tested.
Normal telemetry shall prohibit secrets and shall exclude restricted content unless a separate grant protocol is used.
Restricted-content access shall be purpose-bound time-bounded separately authorized audited retained and region-controlled.
Customer users shall use enterprise federation and strong authentication appropriate to action risk; services shall use workload identity.
Encryption signing and identity keys shall have separate purpose rotation revocation recovery and region/tenant policy.
Support access shall be just-in-time purpose-limited time-bounded and auditable with safe diagnostics as the default.
Retention deletion legal hold backup expiry and data-subject workflows shall propagate across authority and projections.
Each customer-facing and tier-0 capability shall have approved SLIs SLOs error budgets owners dashboards alerts and runbooks.
Capacity shall be modeled for producers events evidence entities relationships activity projections queries decisions commands exports and reconciliation.
Workload classes and per-tenant quotas shall protect ingest control and canonical mutation from batch analytics replay and exports.
Backups shall be encrypted residency-compliant monitored immutable or write-protected and regularly restored.
Regional or cell recovery shall reconcile in-flight commands and accept edge replay without duplicate canonical effects.
Critical incidents shall have independent kill switches for source admission schema processing findings policy commands connectors and evidence access.
Operational telemetry shall be privacy-safe bounded-cardinality tenant-isolated and include data-quality watermarks and invariants.
Every deployable artifact shall have immutable digest signed provenance SBOM compatibility metadata vulnerability state and promotion history.
Production shall promote the tested artifact by digest rather than rebuild from source for the production environment.
Database and data changes shall use backward-compatible mixed-version migrations with progress pause recovery and post-invariants.
The test program shall cover contracts properties components integrations conformance E2E migration performance resilience security privacy UX and production verification.
Release waivers shall record scope impact authority compensating control expiry and follow-up and shall not hide unsupported claims or isolation/durability/control-safety gaps.
Edge runtime and source adapter certification shall bind results to exact signed artifacts support matrices and resource/privacy profiles.
Canary promotion shall evaluate SLO data correctness resolver/materializer/finding diffs authorization privacy cost and rollback readiness.
Quilr 1 records shall be extracted as immutable legacy source evidence with store ID watermark checksum transformation version and limitations.
Legacy IDs shall be preserved as aliases and shall not automatically become Quilr 2 canonical IDs.

Migration parity shall compare entity membership identity lifecycle relationships activity source coverage authorization API export and retention semantics for every capability and domain included in the authorized cohort rather than only counts.
During coexistence each domain shall name one authoritative writer propagation direction idempotency conflict rule and cutover watermark.
Tenant and domain cutovers shall be cohort-based monitored reversible and supported through a declared stabilization window.
Legacy API export user role connector and workflow consumers shall be inventoried and migrated or explicitly retired.
Legacy infrastructure credentials jobs and data shall not be removed until rollback retention legal hold and customer approvals close.
Every implementation item shall trace to a normative requirement customer outcome owner verification and release gate.
Material architecture changes shall use a superseding ADR and shall update affected contracts migration security operations and product language.
Unknown production endpoints regions identities keys owners SLOs capacity and routing values shall remain registered as NEEDS_INPUT until approved.
All tier-0 services workstreams and gate approvals shall have named accountable owners and backups before implementation gate exit.

The bounded first customer DIE release shall use Browser Browser Backend Endpoint LLM Gateway and MCP Gateway on the permanent production path and shall ship canonical discovery inventory evidence activity coverage provenance APIs and UI before findings and policy; Quilr 1 migration and coexistence are a separately authorized parallel track and are not DIE implementation or DIE-GA prerequisites.

A one-sensor synthetic pipeline shall not be treated as proof of the unified estate or as authority for canonical contracts; one normally installed or deployed source may and should prove the first complete integration vertical through the already-frozen permanent five-profile architecture.
verification: Architecture review and exact-artifact vertical trace

requirement: Gate decisions shall bind to immutable artifacts configuration evidence risks exceptions and accountable approvals.
The 32-domain capability taxonomy shall be used as a completeness lens and shall not be implemented as 32 navigation areas services or repositories.
Each customer workflow shall map to an explicit release gate and shall not imply that later or optional capabilities are present in the first GA.

Every integration capability shall be classified as runtime sensor discovery connector telemetry importer control connector or response connector with role-specific authority credentials health and certification.
A package implementing multiple integration roles shall isolate role scopes credentials queues failure state kill switches and authority.
Discovery and telemetry integrations shall emit source evidence and claims and shall not directly mutate canonical entities relationships findings or metrics.
A control or response integration result shall not be presented as verified effect or canonical workflow truth until its governed verification or synchronization rule passes.
Each finding family shall use an immutable versioned definition that owns eligibility coverage grouping temporal lifecycle severity confidence quality rollout recompute and rollback semantics.
Severity confidence source assurance coverage and work priority shall be computed and displayed as separate dimensions.
verification: Finding API and UX contract test

requirement: Finding recompute shall write a candidate namespace produce an impact and quality diff and promote atomically without clearing active findings in place.

Finding windows thresholds scores weights evidence display limits accepted-risk periods and suppression durations shall be versioned definition or policy data and shall not use unapproved universal defaults.
Browser extension client and browser backend service shall have distinct workload identity capability certification lifecycle health coverage and evidence semantics.
Every launch actor shall have an owned security record covering identity authentication authorization secrets data trust boundary audit failure posture blast radius controls runbook and proof.
Every customer-facing feature shall trace from customer claim and workflow through source evidence coverage canonical processing authorization operations acceptance and release gate.
Every tier-0 and tier-1 component shall maintain dependency data-authority actor-security failure-mode version-skew operations and immutable-release metadata.
Tickets wikis catalogs dashboards fixtures mocks and placeholders shall not override architecture or count as production capability proof.
Historical repository branch route storage topology and security claims shall be reverified against current source and deployed runtime before they authorize implementation or release.

Every sensor release shall bind its certified adapter capability manifest and golden traces to the exact audited source revision build provenance artifact digest effective configuration and deployed workload identity.
Endpoint and MCP source paths shall emit source-native identifiers and optional revisioned binding hints and shall not emit producer-created Quilr 2 canonical entity identifiers.

The browser extension background and native messaging host shall use one logical Browser installation producer epoch sequence space WAL and delivery stream while retaining distinct component artifact capability health and lineage; Browser Backend shall use a separate hosted producer and shall emit only server-owned facts or preserve the qualified original Browser producer epoch record and digest when relaying so client activity is never double counted.
verification: Browser compound-artifact producer and relay-lineage certification

requirement: The endpoint compound sensor shall use one supervised installation-scoped Starliner runtime and authenticated bounded least-privilege IPC for every local component adapter.
The Endpoint application resolver and discovered-app synchronization compatibility APIs shall remain outside Quilr 2 canonical identity authority and shall not assign or mutate canonical identity.

Every supported LLM Gateway provider-compatible transport and streaming path shall implement one request lifecycle contract covering authentication route model policy DLP upstream attempt response cancellation timeout and client outcome.
Product-native logs queues caches and database writes shall not be accepted as proof of edge WAL durability or central evidence admission.

MCP Direct OneMCP native tools resources prompts sessions capability negotiation cancellation and progress shall be independently manifested observed and certified and coverage shall not be inferred across surfaces.
Browser endpoint LLM and MCP ordinary hot-path decisions shall evaluate an active local signed bundle; central decision calls shall be bounded explicit escalation with a typed unavailable posture.

Static source verification shall not be represented as proof of remote currency deployed artifact optional dependency effective production configuration runtime behavior scale reliability or customer exposure.

Source-verified private key material unauthenticated local IPC producer-created canonical IDs and equivalent trust-boundary violations shall block affected capability certification until remediated and incident-disposition evidence is approved.

Every installed or deployed source integration shall bind the official exact artifact existing organization tenant Discovery or signed bootstrap authenticated installation and producer enrollment renewable workload credential secure store normal supervisor or entrypoint native capture WAL sender and receipt owner; customers and sensors shall not be required to invent a second Quilr 2 tenant.

verification: Required-input disposition lint and prohibited-bypass mutation tests
